_comment: What panes reads: every pane of the multiplexer it runs in - Rex, Herdr or Luvus - through that multiplexer's CLI, read-only. A rex_panes, herdr_panes or luvus_panes section from before is read when there is no panes section.
_backend_comment: Which multiplexer to read. auto finds out from the pane panes runs in: REX_SESSION and REX_BLOCK for Rex, HERDR_ENV=1 for Herdr, LUVUS_ENV=1 for Luvus, and the nearest of them in the process tree when several are set. The --mux flag overrides this.
_rex_server_comment: Which Rex server to read: a host label from `rex hosts`, or an address. Empty means the CLI's own default - REX_SERVER when it is set, else this machine's server. Set, it is read from anywhere, inside a multiplexer or not. CPU and memory are shown only for this machine's server.
_luvus_session_comment: Under Luvus, which Luvus server session to read. `luvus session list` names the ones on this machine; `default` is the one `luvus` starts on its own.
_refresh_comment: Maximum idle delay in seconds; Rex events wake a full read sooner.
_agents_comment: Under Rex, command names that count as coding agents; Herdr and Luvus name their agents themselves. Matched against the pane's foreground program, and against the app name a program reports with OSC 7501 (claude also matches a report from claude-code or claude-cli).
